audit.whatIsWrong: Every full-layer phases[].side read 'Skill' while content win[] and the packet levelChart read Skill, Katarina, Katarina, Skill, Katarina, Ekko, Ekko.
audit.why: The content chart matches the kit: Shunpo (12/11/10/9/8, 725 range) and Bouncing Blade (11s) give Katarina levels 2-3 and the pre-6 window, while Ekko's stun cancelling a 75-second Death Lotus channel plus item power gives him the later rows.
audit.corrected: phases[1], [2] and [4] moved to Katarina and [5], [6] to Ekko, with those whys and ratings rewritten in the same group. win[] already holds these values, so no win[N] value change exists to pair.

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[0] named 'Sinister Steel', which is not in Katarina's kit.
audit.why: Her W is Preparation (15/14/13/12/11) — a move-speed burst that tosses a dagger above her.
audit.corrected: spikes[0] rewritten around Bouncing Blade on 11s, Preparation's dagger and speed, and Shunpo's 725-range blink onto a dropped dagger.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page never stated the two decisive interactions, and spikes[1] claimed she 'can Shunpo away from your stun setup mid-channel'.
audit.why: Death Lotus is a channel that any CC cancels, so entering Parallel Convergence's anomaly stuns her out of the ultimate outright; Shunpo cast mid-channel would end her own channel. Death Lotus also applies Grievous Wounds, which cuts what Chronobreak heals back — the single most important number in this matchup and it appeared nowhere.
audit.corrected: Both written into spikes[1], phases[4].why, phases[5].why, breakdown.mid, dosFull[1].d, dontsFull[0].d and wants.foe[2].
sources: brief enemyKit R flags channel + antiHeal

audit.why: Shunpo 12/11/10/9/8, Bouncing Blade 11/10/9/8/7, Death Lotus 75/60/45, Chronobreak 110/80/50 are all in the kits.
audit.corrected: Real numbers written in, with Shunpo's downtime named as the commit window.

audit.whatIsWrong: 17 misgendering fields (Katarina called he/his/him), dosFull[1].d was tradeGood verbatim, dontsFull[2].d was tradeBad verbatim, and dosFull[2].t promised a 'post-combo silence' that does not exist in her kit.
audit.why: Katarina is female per champ-gender.js; Do's bodies must explain their own titles; Katarina has no silence.
audit.corrected: Pronouns fixed, both bled bullets replaced with kit-grounded bodies, and dosFull[2].t retitled to the real trigger (Shunpo spent).

audit.whatIsWrong: Two derived flags in the brief misfire: Bouncing Blade carries a 'grounding' flag and Preparation a 'knockup' flag, and _missing then asserted that Bouncing Blade can deny Phase Dive.
audit.why: Riot's own descriptions have no grounding and no displacement — Q bounces daggers, W is a move-speed burst that tosses a dagger upward. Per the brief's rule, the description wins over the flag.
audit.corrected: I wrote nothing about grounding or knockup anywhere. The suspectNames hits ('Ekko's Parallel Convergence', 'Save Parallel Convergence', 'Land Bouncing Blade', 'Bouncing Blade-') are all false positives — real names with prefixes attached.
